source.name: HYG Database v4.4
source.citation: HYG Database v4.4, David Nash / Astronexus (https://codeberg.org/astronexus/hyg), licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Compiled from the Hipparcos catalogue (ESA 1997; new reduction van Leeuwen 2007), the Yale Bright Star Catalogue (5th ed.) and the Gliese Catalogue of Nearby Stars (3rd ed.).

provenance.xPc: derived: HYG dist * unit vector(HYG ra, dec); dist = 1/parallax (Hipparcos 2007 reduction, else YBSC/Gliese)
provenance.absMagV: derived: HYG mag - 5 log10(dist / 10 pc); no extinction correction
provenance.colorIndexBV: observed: HYG ci (B-V); NaN when unknown
provenance.teffK: derived: Ballesteros (2012) black-body formula T = 4600 K [1/(0.92(B-V)+1.7) + 1/(0.92(B-V)+0.62)], B-V clamped to [-0.4, 2]; NaN when B-V unknown. Rendering aid, not a measured temperature.

frame: Heliocentric equatorial Cartesian, ICRS-aligned (Hipparcos reference frame), equinox J2000.0, positions at epoch J2000.0 (as propagated by HYG). +X toward RA=0h Dec=0, +Y toward RA=6h Dec=0, +Z toward the north celestial pole. Sun at the origin.
sortOrder: apparent V magnitude ascending (brightest first), ties by HYG id; every prefix [0, n) is a valid magnitude-limited LOD subset. Apparent magnitude = absMagV + 5 log10(r / 10 pc), r = |(x,y,z)|.

nan.policy: Only colorIndexBV and teffK may be NaN (B-V unknown in HYG). Positions and absMagV are always finite.

exclusionRules.sun: HYG id 0 ("Sol") is excluded; the Sun is provided by the solar-system domain.
exclusionRules.distanceSentinel: HYG dist >= 100000 pc = missing or negative Hipparcos parallax (HYG placeholder).

notes: Distances come from parallaxes; for stars beyond a few hundred pc Hipparcos parallax errors are large and some HYG distances (up to tens of kpc) are unreliable. HYG does not carry parallax uncertainties.
Hipparcos-era data; Gaia DR3 distances for most of these stars exist (see AT-HYG). Gaia DR4 is scheduled for 2026-12-02 and is NOT used.
Index i of a star in this file is the "index" used by stars-named.json, hip-index.json, star-systems.json and constellations.json; byte offset = i * 24.
